Ivy (Marketing): Quick pitch 1: run a 28-minute "Build & Benchmark" session for console triers. Hook = small benchmark table + 90 starter credits split. Thoughts?
Tom (Growth): Yes. Make it hands-on: 3 curated prompts, each with a one-click "Run in Console" button during demo. Recommend 30 credits on signup, 60 gated after checklist.
Rae (Product): We can surface per-prompt token estimates and an inline cost line (e.g., ~45 tokens, ~$0.00X) live in the UI. That benchmark narrative helps with trust.
Noor (Onboarding): Checklist proposal: 1) create API key, 2) run any one demo prompt, 3) save that prompt to library. Unlocks the remaining 60 credits on completion.
Sam (Ops): Routing note: demo traffic -> pool `bench-demo-v3`, fallback `hosted-core`. Add org-level cap (max 3 grantees) and credits expire in 30d. Pseudo policy:
``ncohort: bench-apr
pool: bench-demo-v3
fallback: hosted-core
per_user_cap: 90
expiry_days: 30
```
Ivy (Marketing): Landing copy sketch: "Build an LLM feature in 28 minutes — live prompts, real metrics, 90 credits to try in your app." Keep headline tight.
Tom (Growth): Experiment arms: A) 90 upfront, B) 30/60 gated, holdout 30% baseline. Primary metrics: landing CVR, attendance, first-3-API-call conversion, prompt-save rate, 7-day retention, net-new orgs. Also watch credit burn per cohort.
Rae (Product): We'll instrument per-prompt latency + avg tokens and include a tiny benchmark table in the post-event email. Narrative example: "50-token prompt ≈ 160ms on demo pool, cost ~$0.00Y."
Noor (Onboarding): UI: show progress modal and visible credit balance after unlock. Less support friction. I'll draft copy by EOD.
Sam (Ops): I'll add routing + guard rails. Quick ask: should we also restrict promo to accounts created within last 90 days? That reduces reuse.
Ivy (Marketing): Yes, target recent console triers. Promo channels: in-app banner, short email to recent signups, small LinkedIn dev-lead push, and a same-day benchmark blog.
SchedBot: Event scheduled: "Build & Benchmark: 28m hands-on session" on 2026-04-11 16:00 UTC. Attendees: Ivy, Tom, Rae, Sam, Noor.
Ivy (Marketing): Action items recap: Tom = experiment wiring + cohorts, Rae = prompt packs + telemetry, Noor = checklist + modal copy, Sam = route + caps, I'll draft landing & blog. Reconvene after drafts. :rocket:
